unit_resampled: replicate ID within each (target, N) cell
pairing: all methods carried together on the resampled replicate IDs
target_index: NEVER resampled - the 15 targets are a fixed benchmark
limitations: A percentile bootstrap CI is not a p-value and no test is derived from it here.
Resampling 30 replicate IDs cannot represent uncertainty about the choice of benchmark densities; between-target spread is reported separately and is not uncertainty of the benchmark mean.
ISE distributions are right-skewed; medians are reported alongside means as a robustness summary.
The bootstrap resamples stored metric rows only. Nothing is refitted.
